ram_model: No malloc. Static .bss 280 B: regex_t re_compiled[30] (8 B each on 32-bit: type byte + union{ch, ccl ptr}) = 240 B + unsigned char ccl_buf[40] = 40 B, inside re_compile -> non-reentrant, exactly one compiled pattern alive at a time; patterns with >29 objects are SILENTLY truncated (compile loop stops), >39 total class bytes -> compile returns NULL. Stack: matchpattern is iterative over plain atoms; matchstar/matchplus/matchquestion each recurse into matchpattern for the rest of the pattern, so recursion depth <= number of quantifiers in the pattern (<= ~15 given the 30-object cap), independent of text length; frames are small (~24-40 B). Time is exponential for nested stars: 'a*a*a*a*a*a*a*a*b' on 30 a's = 1.97 s on the host.
features_verified:
Read from re.c and confirmed with hand probes. IMPLEMENTED: literal bytes; '.' (matches ANY byte incl. 
 by default; -DRE_DOT_MATCHES_NEWLINE=0 excludes 
 and ); '^' only as first pattern object; '$' only as last object; '*' and '+' greedy with backtracking; '?' NON-greedy (tries zero first: 'a?' on 'a' -> [0,0]; documented as such); classes [abc], negated [^abc], ranges a-z, \d\w\s\D\W\S and \-style escapes inside classes, literal '-' at class edges; \d \D \w \W \s \S via ctype (isdigit/isalpha/isspace; \w = alpha|digit|'_'; locale/ctype-table dependent); '\X' for any other X = literal X (so \. \* \[ work); search-anywhere (re_matchp returns start index, *matchlength = length). NOT IMPLEMENTED: alternation '|' (code commented out, '|' is a literal), groups '(' ')' '(?:' (literal parens), {n,m} (literal braces), lazy quantifiers *? +? ?? (a '?' after a quantifier is compiled as a stray QUESTIONMARK object and never matches), captures (API exposes only start+length), case-insensitive mode (none), UTF-8 awareness ('.' and classes consume one byte),   \B \A \Z, escape sequences 
 	  \xhh (
 matches letter 'n'), backreferences. BUGS: an empty match ending at end-of-text is reported as nomatch ('' on '', '$' on 'abc', 'a*' on ''); '^' not at start / '$' not at end compare a stale union byte (effectively nomatch); pattern >29 objects silently truncated; exponential backtracking on nested quantifiers; README/re.h still flag inverted classes as 'broken' though [^..] cases in the corpus largely pass.

README's Python-based random tests (scripts/regex_test.py + exrex, 36 patterns x N strings) only check that a Python-matching string ALSO matches somewhere in the C engine (exit code of tests/test_rand), not the span or greediness, so they cannot see the '?'-greediness, '$'-alone and empty-match bugs found here; the hand-picked tests/test1.c and generated test2.c (197 KB) and a KLEE harness (formal_verification.md, memory safety only) are the other tests. The corpus's 264 patterns with >29 objects would be silently truncated, but none surfaced as primary cause since all also use | or (). ESP32/xtensa char signedness not verified here; if signed (unverified), high-byte literals would fail there as on the Apple host. Engine is not reentrant (static compiled-pattern buffer) and has no error reporting beyond NULL from re_compile. Everything reported here was measured/read locally; no README figure was taken on trust.
